Welcome to this stunning brand-new townhouse in the highly sought-after Murooj Al Furjan West, a vibrant gated community in Al Furjan, Dubai. Designed with families in mind, this spacious home offers modern comfort, natural light, and excellent connectivity — all within a peaceful, green setting.

Property Details:
• Plot Size: 2,786.88 sq. ft.
• 3 Generously Sized Bedrooms – Each with en-suite bathroom
• Maid’s Room
• Bright, Open-Plan Living & Dining Area
• Modern Kitchen
• Built-in Wardrobes & Ample Storage
• Private Garden
• Storage Room
• Single Row Unit – Added privacy
• Unfurnished – Customize to your taste
• Covered Parking

Community Features:
• Secure, Gated Family Community
• Lush Parks and Landscaped Green Spaces
• Swimming Pools & Fully Equipped Fitness Centers
• Children’s Play Areas
• Quick access to Sheikh Zayed Road & Al Yalayis Road
• Minutes from Ibn Battuta Mall and Discovery Gardens Metro Station
• Rental Price: AED 220,000

This thoughtfully designed home is ideal for families seeking a calm, connected lifestyle with all the amenities you need at your doorstep.

Contact Provident Real Estate today to schedule your private viewing and make this home yours.
